why: Interviewers start broad, then drill into why each tool was chosen, what else was considered, what broke, and how each number was measured, often asking about the same point twice. An overview alone shows the project works; the layers below show you built it.
sentence: To do X, I used Y, because Z, and it gave W.
hand_off: I can go deeper on the ingestion, the design choices, or how it is deployed. Which is most useful?

layers.name: 20-second version
layers.prompt: The problem, what you built, and the result, in two or three sentences. Stop here and let them choose where to go.

layers.name: Walk the data flow, naming each tool
layers.prompt: Every step from source to output: the tool at that step, what it does there, and why it is there. One step per line.

layers.name: Decisions
layers.prompt: Three or four 'why X, not Y' answers: the alternative you considered, the constraint that decided it, and what it cost. One per line: question :: answer.

layers.name: Hardest problem
layers.prompt: The symptom, how you found the cause, the root cause, the fix, and how you proved it worked.

layers.name: How each number was measured
layers.prompt: For every number you claim: the baseline, the method and the time period. One per line: claim :: how it was measured.

layers.name: Your part
layers.prompt: What you owned and decided yourself, and what the team or others did.

layers.name: What you would change
layers.prompt: What you would do differently today, and what would break first at ten times the scale.

layers.name: Follow-up questions
layers.prompt: The questions they are likely to ask next, each with a two or three sentence answer. One per line: question :: answer.

layers.name: Skills it proves
layers.prompt: Each skill this item proves, with one line on where you used it. One per line: skill :: where.

layers.name: Say only if asked
layers.prompt: Things not to overstate: approximate numbers, removed features, work that was partly someone else's.

cert_layers.name: One-line answer
cert_layers.prompt: What the certificate is and why you took it.

cert_layers.name: What it covered
cert_layers.prompt: The main areas, one per line.

cert_layers.name: Concepts you can explain cold
cert_layers.prompt: Three concepts from it, one per line, that you can explain without notes.

cert_layers.name: Where you used it
cert_layers.prompt: A project or role where you applied it, with the result.

cert_layers.name: Questions on its content
cert_layers.prompt: Interviewers sometimes quiz the certificate itself. One per line: question :: answer.

cert_layers.name: Say only if asked
cert_layers.prompt: Anything about it not to overstate.
